name: OpenET field-scale evapotranspiration service
description: The OpenET consortium built a public platform that estimates evapotranspiration at field scale. It makes individual and combined results from six models available using Landsat observations and other inputs. Its initial coverage of 17 western states expanded to all 48 contiguous states in 2025.
why: The consortium sought to give water managers and farmers accessible field-scale evapotranspiration estimates as drought and other pressures tightened available water supplies in the western United States.

links.statement: The deployed OpenET Collection 2.0 SSEBop model uses Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 land surface temperature. Its image implementation accepts Landsat 8 Level-2 scenes with both reflectance and temperature bands.
links.scope: OpenET Collection 2.0 SSEBop. Other ensemble models have distinct input requirements.

evidence.supports: OpenET records operational use of the USGS science product in this model.
